Armed with one fixed beam laser, usable only at dogfighting range. Can land at Alell’s surface starport, which the Event Horizon can’t. Could shuttle fuel up from Alell, at a price
Session 2026-09-27: kept docked during the fight with Delta 2. Flying it would split the crew
Session 2026-10-04: stayed docked through the fight. Afterwards it took the Five High Passengers down to Alell, the Event Horizon being unable to land or dock anywhere. It’s now the crew’s only way to the surface
Session 2026-10-18: flew the party and Vlen’s cryotube down to the Alell Starport, into the mouth of the pyramid, and was disinfected on arrival. Left parked at the starport, which is safe and has plenty of room, with the party’s firearms aboard, since guns are banned on Alell

investigation-status.title: Investigation Status
investigation-status.content:
traveller sota clue
Secrets of the Ancients
Running state of the investigation into Vlen Backett’s Murder, from the GM’s board.
Timeline
Current date: shortly after c. 219-1105, midday, at Vlen’s homecoming in Vaca Goya on Alell. Burial and will reading tomorrow. Porter Sajan has asked Kostas to resolve the Claims on Vlen’s Estate first. The Event Horizon is still in orbit, badly damaged.





























































































DateEvent—Vlen Backett arrives on Regina from Rhylanor, three days before his death—Vlen murdered in Credo City — exact date not given, but on or before 190185-1105The party leave Yori190-1105Pallod Norrim’s comms sent from the POC Regina Office informing the party of Vlen’s death; Handout 2 sealed the same day193-1105The party arrive at Regina195-1105Winter Shipping reconnoitred and hacked; cargo sold to them as cover; Pallod stops taking calls195-1105Meeting at the Flotsam, 10pm — happened. Odoy names Ven Yasha as the killer195-1105, nightBreak-in at Winter Shipping’s Credo-side office. Exceedingly Discreet found; the tunnel between the buildings confirmed196-1105, small hoursDeal struck with Exceedingly Discreet: passage to the base in exchange for Harlen’s death196-1105Launch rendezvous with the Event Horizon; crew armed; Gunner Gunnerson joins, Graxius StClair drops out196-1105The hidden base (Winter Shipping Station) boarded and cleared. Seven-plus staff killed196-1105Harlen triggers the self-destruct by closing his eyes. Vlen’s Statuette and Data Crystals taken off his desk196-1105The base is destroyed. The crew escape by capsule and land outside the Twin Cities—The Alahir has departed Regina, date not givenc. 197-1105The crew leave Regina for Alell via Forboldn and Whanga, five high passengers aboardc. 197–204First jump: Helix / Black Horizon row settled for Black Horizonc. 205–211Second jump: one passenger turns out to be a shapeshifting alien in its mating season (Five High Passengers)c. 212–218Third jump: Black Horizon’s [[Carthusc. 219-1105Arrival at Alell. Delta 2 hails as an Alell patrol, goes dark and fires missilesc. 219-1105Delta 2 destroyed by the Event Horizon’s missiles. The Event Horizon left at Hull 47 of 124 with a damaged jump drive. Passengers landed by the Implacableshortly afterDown to Alell. Customs scanner glitches on Vlen’s cryotube. Rao flies the party to Vaca Goya and sells Rao’s Map. At the homecoming: no will; the Brotherhood of Humaniti, Orisa Backett, Yusul Parad and Marisa Jocell all claim the estate. Porter Sajan hands the claims to Kostas
The dates put the party’s departure from Yori five days before the death notice was sent, but the party’s understanding is that they left because of the notice. Most likely a slip in the GM’s dates rather than something in the fiction — treated as such unless it comes up in play.
What the party are concentrating on

Security footage — ✅ obtained and viewed. Three Men at Vlen’s Room
Meeting at the Flotsam — ✅ happened. Detective Odoy’s account is the counter-theory to the POC’s
Winter Shipping — ✅ broken into 195-1105, and its orbital base boarded and destroyed 196-1105. The company’s real records are still a Llellewyoly sat in Credo
Vlen’s Statuette and Data Crystals — ✅ recovered, unexamined
Harlen — ✅ found, and lost again. Fate unknown; he controlled the station without touching it
Darrian Jak — the crew are fairly confident he is a fall guy. The prison visit has now slipped twice
What is this device that was used? — The Device, still unidentified, and now worth re-reading against Harlen
Alahir — has left Regina. Its Imperial Intelligence contingent’s business is reportedly concluded

Where the party are now — end of session, 196-1105
In wild land on the outskirts of the Twin Cities on Regina, with grav bikes and a ride back into the city.

They hold a statuette and a set of data disks off Harlen’s desk. Nobody has examined either. The statuette resembles the Ancient material in Iaros Ujinka’s house
Kostas Backett is at STR 1, DEX 2, END 1 — needs surgery, cannot heal on rest, and his own first aid failed. The Event Horizon’s sickbay is the fix
The base is gone, along with whatever the overlong launch runs were actually carrying and most of the company’s staff
Exceedingly Discreet does not know yet. Its company’s orbital operation has been destroyed, the crew were the last people aboard, and it wanted the company for itself
Harlen may be alive. “This is not the end,” repeated, is not a dying man’s line
Iaros Ujinka’s request that the Event Horizon back Ujinka’s Research is still unanswered

The new headline question — how Harlen ran the station
He saw Kostas, recognised him, looked at Cassius’ uniform, said “This is suboptimal” and shut his eyes. Every screen went black and the destruct sequence ran. No console, no keypad, no spoken command.
Unexplained. Candidates: psionics, a neural implant wired into the base, or something touching The Ancients. Set it against:

The Device carried by the third man at Dancado, which caused electrical interference nobody could account for
The localised systems failures Kostas raised with Pallod Norrim, who called them coincidence
Smashed Comms — Vlen’s comms failed in a way that made them unusable
The Zhodani, for whom psionics are institutional, and the Imperium’s hostility to psionic talent

He also knew the crew on sight — Kostas by face, Cassius by uniform.
Superseded — where the party were in the small hours of 196-1105
Inside Winter Shipping’s closed Credo-side office, having struck a deal with Exceedingly Discreet.

The company’s real records were a Llellewyoly on a closed system — unhackable, but talkative
Harlen ran Winter Shipping and Ven Yasha owns it. Exceedingly Discreet wanted Harlen gone and the company for itself
The deal: the company launch and passage to the base, flight path set from its console, Marid none the wiser; in return Harlen dies and the conversation never happened
Ven Yasha ordered Iaros Ujinka’s death (per Exceedingly Discreet, who cannot explain why), and Vlen Backett was Yasha’s messenger who “brought bad news”
Everything above is Exceedingly Discreet’s word. It refuses to discuss Ven Yasha himself at all

Current actions

Get Kostas into surgery — the ship’s sickbay or a Regina hospital
Examine the statuette and the data disks
Establish whether Harlen is dead, and what he actually was
Decide how to handle Exceedingly Discreet — gone from the Credo office by the morning of 196-1105; not found
Answer Ujinka — whether the Event Horizon takes on Ujinka’s Research
Still open, deprioritised: meet Darrian Jak in prison to test Pallod’s case

Both people who knew what Ujinka’s Research was about are dead — Vlen Backett on or before 190, Ujinka on 195. The party are the only ones left who were told, and they were in the room when it happened.
Legal exposure
Regina is Law Level 9: most personal weapons are banned outright, and POC officers may detain people or confiscate items merely “disruptive or damaging to public order and safety”. Assumption of Custody then allows a month’s detention without trial, with Travellers swept as routine.
The tally now includes a dead professor on the Duke’s private land at Dancado, a break-in at a Credo business, seven-plus dead aboard a destroyed installation, and four armed off-worlders who have just come down in an escape capsule at a recovery point somebody presumably monitors. Whoever sent the crew will also notice they haven’t reported back.
Closed

The receptionist on duty the night of the murder — traced and spoken to. Nothing useful. Not Zena Antonia, who works the same desk on other shifts
The overlong launch runs — the destination is established: the hidden base at the Lagrangian point. What they carried is not, and the evidence is now vapour

Loose threads not on the party’s list

Claims on Vlen’s Estate — four claimants and no will, to be sorted before tomorrow’s will reading
Vlen fled the Brotherhood of Humaniti, signing everything over on joining. They found his homeworld only now, and want a “DNA” ceremony
Yusul says Vlen traded in ancient artefacts, and knows who he was involved with
The customs scanner glitched on Vlen’s cryotube. Unexplained
Vlen’s Hidden Fortune — Hans Backett says Vlen hid a fortune in his old lodge on Alell, and is thought to be looking for an angle
Vlen’s debt to Yusul Parad — borrowed about ten years ago from the Parad Family gang, per Kostas’s parents. Repaid or not is unknown
The burial — the Backett Family are gathering to bury Vlen, and the crew have brought his body to Alell
What was in the tunnel between the two Winter Shipping buildings — the newer pipe with vents at equal intervals, and the closed Star Town ramp
Was Exceedingly Discreet playing the crew into removing Harlen for it, or into a fight it expected them to lose? They won, and then lost it the company
The base’s gun emplacement — Ozy opened a door onto it and never went in
The Alahir’s captain — heard as “Gand Hulses”, spelling unconfirmed; said to hold a special portfolio in Imperial Intelligence
Detective Odoy himself — which agency he serves and what he wants from the crew
Being Followed — the departing grav car appeared to be POC, but local officers denied another unit was present
Is Pallod Norrim bought, coerced, or sidelined?
Imperial takeover — Odoy says the Zhodani-spy story is a fabrication covering the Imperial seizure of the inquiry. Unverified
Iaros Ujinka’s murder is unexplained — even Ven Yasha’s own records-keeper could not account for the order
Vlen Backett’s True Age — Kostas researched it and found nothing new
The Vargr cluster — The Ancients uplifted them, the Church of the Chosen Ones claims their inheritance, Tusal came from their extents, and Vargr once crossed hundreds of parsecs to see Vlen

Notes

196-1105: the crew left Regina for Alell without reporting to Detective Odoy, and without finding Exceedingly Discreet. The active investigation is now the material aboard: Ujinka’s Research, the Boughene statue and Vlen’s disks, which point at Boughene and at Juni on Beck’s World (Corrected: Vlen’s body did come with them.)

Transit, Session 2026-09-20: nothing touched the investigation. Two jumps of ship trouble — the research row, the passenger-blob, the carthus breach — and the crew are days out from Alell. Vlen’s family, his burial and the Cr300,000 are the next real moves
Arrival, Session 2026-09-27: still nothing on the investigation itself. The carthus hunt ended, and the ship came out of jump at Alell into a fight with Delta 2, which claims to be an Alell patrol ship when Alell has none. Whether anyone at Alell was waiting for this ship — for Vlen’s next of kin, or for Black Horizon’s cargo — is an open question, not a conclusion
Alell, Session 2026-10-04: the fight ended with Delta 2 destroyed. Per the GM it was a Far Trader (missile rack, beam laser); the table read it as pirates, and the GM framed it as going after a lab ship it thought was easy pickings. Nobody was identified, so whether it was waiting for this ship stays open. Chapter 2 is mostly NPCs, some of them Kostas’s family, presumably (an inference) where Vlen’s family, his burial and the investigation’s Alell end come in
Alell, Session 2026-10-18: the investigation came to the crew. Nairal Backett independently supports Vlen Backett’s True Age. Yusul Parad says Vlen traded in ancient artefacts. The Brotherhood of Humaniti claim him as a runaway initiate. And Vlen’s lodge in the woods, which off-world visitors used, may be marked on Rao’s Map. The cryotube glitched the customs scanner. See Claims on Vlen’s Estate

irregularities-in-vlen-backett's-affairs.title: Irregularities in Vlen Backett's Affairs
irregularities-in-vlen-backett's-affairs.content:
traveller sota clue
Secrets of the Ancients
From Handout 2, Pallod Norrim’s death notification:

Given certain irregularities with Vlen Backett’s affairs, it is vitally important that you contact the Public Order Commission upon arrival.

Unspecified. The Regina Public Order Commission won’t say what they are in writing, which is itself worth noting.
What’s unexplained

What the irregularities actually are
Why he pre-registered Kostas Backett as next of kin, given how little contact the family had with his real life
Why a drifter with no visible income had money on deposit at the First Ducal Bank and heard from nobility, naval officers and Vargr

Since answered

How he died — the letter never said. The coroner’s report does: Vlen Backett’s Murder. Norrim wrote to summon his next of kin without once mentioning he’d been shot, which may be the whole of the “irregularities” or may be a separate problem.
The report also turned up something the letter didn’t hint at: Vlen Backett’s True Age.

Notes

Pallod later claimed Darrian Jak murdered Vlen and treated the case as closed, without explaining the irregularities that originally made Kostas’s presence “vitally important”.

jocell-family.title: Jocell Family
jocell-family.content:
traveller sota faction alell
Secrets of the Ancients
A branch of the Backett Family on Alell, descended from a cousin who left Vaca Goya to find work in the starport.
They consider themselves cultured and cosmopolitan and look down on their “country bumpkin cousins”, the Backetts. Kostas’s parents had little to do with them.
The Jocell delegation is led by Marisa Jocell, with her son Bard Jocell.
Source: Tel’s pre-session handout on Alell, mostly what Kostas’s parents have told him.
See the Alell Family Tree for the whole family and everyone else at the homecoming, on one page.
Notes


Session 2026-10-18: Marisa and Bard at the homecoming. They live and work in the starport area, not Vaca Goya. Marisa claims Vlen “owes me his spaceship”

juni.title: Juni
juni.content:
traveller sota npc
Secrets of the Ancients
Graxius StClair’s ex-wife. Iaros Ujinka went to work with her, which is a sore subject for StClair — he reacted when her name came up in Ujinka’s notes on 196-1105.
Ujinka’s Research Note 1 (see Ujinka’s Research) says Juni and her team will be investigating the g-band signals further at the Beck’s World Ancients site — so she is there now, carrying on the work that has so far got two people killed.
Name heard as “Juni”; spelling unconfirmed.
Notes

kaldi-research.title: Kaldi Research
kaldi-research.content:
traveller sota faction
Secrets of the Ancients
A private corporation with two main branches:

The bulk of its assets are in fixed installations doing research on contract for corporate bodies and planetary governments
A much smaller proportion goes into operating a number of laboratory ships that travel throughout the Marches and beyond, either hiring out their services to whoever needs a general research team, or engaging in ongoing studies

Why this is in the file
The Event Horizon is a Lab Ship. Kaldi runs lab ships around the Marches for hire. That makes them the obvious commercial answer to the question Ujinka’s Research posed — and a party with a lab ship looking to do Ancients fieldwork is either Kaldi’s competition, Kaldi’s cover, or Kaldi’s next contract.
Nothing established connects Kaldi to either murder, or to Ujinka. Noted because the shape matches.
Notes

kan.title: Kan
kan.content:
traveller sota location
Secrets of the Ancients
Site named in Iaros Ujinka’s Research Note 3 (see Ujinka’s Research): the Vilani records of thousands of years ago logged the site at Kan as “just another precursor society” — shimmering glass harder than diamond, containers of unblemished un-corroded cobalt, classified as dead rubbish. Ujinka’s conference notes take it as proof the Vilani missed what The Ancients were.
Where Kan is, and whether it’s a world or a site on one, is not stated.
Notes

khei.title: Khei
khei.content:
traveller sota npc
Secrets of the Ancients
Black Horizon’s representative aboard the Event Horizon — empowered to settle any matter concerning their research team, which is why “refer it to head office” didn’t work on her. The GM plays her with a cat picture.
Came out on top of the Helix / Black Horizon ownership row in the first jump out of Regina when Ozy’s analysis of the logs put the discovery squarely with Black Horizon. She thinks Ozy looks like one of her exes; he spent part of the week chatting her up, the roll succeeded, and it went to fade to black.
Name heard at the table as “Kay” / “K”. Spelled Khei in the filename of the GM’s portrait, saved 2026-10-18; this note was renamed from Kay.
Appearance

A lioness-like feline in a black Black Horizon jacket and skirt, gold circlet, tablet in hand.
Notes


Session 2026-09-27: after the carthus hunt Ozy went to her room. A Carousing check gave him DM+3 on Advocate, Effect +7, and she gave him the lowdown: frozen carthus embryos plus Black Horizon’s Growth Serum, contact by accident, instant growth. The embryos are destroyed and the serum kept, and she offered the serum to the crew in return for keeping quiet. Then she kicked Ozy out for a “growth hormone, eh?” joke. Still friendly enough to pat him on the bum when he warned her about the incoming “authorities” at Alell
Session 2026-10-18: portrait shown and spelling settled as Khei (see above). Recapped for StClair as Black Horizon’s “cat woman” rep, “well in there” with Ozy

knorbes.content:

kostas-backett.title: Kostas Backett
kostas-backett.content:
traveller sota character
Secrets of the Ancients
Kostas Backett
38 years old. Ex-Navy (Flight), Petty Officer 3rd class — busted out after backing Tyrus Cassius’s failed mutiny. Burn scars across his upper body from a cryo accident, a cheap prosthetic arm from a boarding action gone wrong, and a glass eye bought with borrowed money. Low SOC, no connections, and just enough skills to be useful on someone else’s ship.
Characteristics
STR 7 · DEX 10 · END 7 · INT 9 (+1 from mustering out) · EDU 8 · SOC 2
Current condition — Vaca Goya, Alell, the day of the homecoming
Home, and holding everyone’s problems. Fit. Went down without a protective suit, after the GM left it to the player whether Kostas is acclimatised to the plant gas. He plans to buy a vacc suit while here. Carries a cutlass on his hip, and lent StClair’s stun stick to Ozy.

Has Rao’s Map, bought from the shuttle pilot Rao for Cr100, marking where she once dropped Vlen in the jungle. He thinks it’s Vlen’s lodge, and has shown it to no one. He has Rao’s number
Told Porter Sajan he had Vlen’s will, then admitted he didn’t. Sajan has made him the intermediary for every claim on the estate (Claims on Vlen’s Estate), without asking
His parents are here and well. His mother Henna Backett dotes on the Admiral; his father Merrick Backett thinks he looks a mess. Nairal Backett cried to see him. Yusul Parad says he trusts Kostas “to do the right thing” about the Cr1,000,000. Orisa Backett calls him her nephew. Marisa Jocell remembers him as a snotty little boy
Took the Admiral everywhere, arm in arm, to show off. Promised to let Yusul know first if any artefacts turn up

Previous condition — in orbit over Alell, c. 219-1105
Fit, and conscious at the end of a fight for once. In Session 2026-10-04 he moved from the laser turret to sensors, since he was the only one aboard with Electronics (sensors) (1). He detected Delta 2’s first launch (rolled 8) and its second launch (Electronic Warfare, Effect 0). His other EW attempts failed (6, then a fail), and so did a Sensor Lock in round 5. No missiles were stopped. He launched no missiles himself, but the Admiral had told him to “stop being cheap” about firing them.
Alell is home. The GM said this chapter’s NPCs include Kostas’s family, and that Alell is where he was born before he moved away. That conflicts with the Homeworld section below (Roup, from character creation); not yet reconciled.
Previous condition — Alell system, c. 219-1105
Fit again, per the GM (“I really don’t want you knackered”), and on a laser turret for the fight with Delta 2.
In the Session 2026-09-27 carthus hunt: dodged a 16-damage lunge at his face, opened the control-room door, finished one carthus there, then killed two more in the corridor: one blown apart when he fired without aiming, one shot dead. Three kills in all. Then one leapt on his back: 19 damage, 14 after armour 5, which took END 0 and STR 0 (DEX 10). Unconscious, even after a dodge and a leadership assist from Cassius. StClair used the medikit Kostas had on him (effect counted as 1), then operated in the medbay: DM+1, plus a boon die for having just done the same operation, Effect +3, END +3, then daily recovery. The table’s running joke is that he’s unconscious after every fight. His first question on waking was whether the Admiral was all right.
Previous condition — third jump to Alell, c. 215-1105
Fully recovered — STR 7 · DEX 10 · END 7 by the arrival at Whanga. Out of the medbay, coffees resumed. Barred from training in the first jump (“not while recovering in the medbay”), one week of Streetwise banked in the second. Now in the maintenance shafts hunting carthuses with StClair’s stun stick — stunned the first one with it (2D6−1, one hit) after the security officer missed, and took the rear of the marching order.
Previous condition — 196-1105, after the raid on the Winter Shipping Station
Surgery done, 196-1105. StClair operated in the Event Horizon’s medbay and succeeded: END 1 → 5. Now on daily medical care in jump — plan is END to 7 and DEX up on day one, DEX full on day two, STR restored within about four days. Two days already banked.
Before that: STR 1 · DEX 2 · END 1. All three physical characteristics damaged, which meant surgery — a hospital or sickbay, not first aid — and he could not heal on rest: a Traveller needing surgery regains only their END DM per day, and his END DM was negative.

























WasNowSTR71DEX102END71
Shot for 3 through his flak jacket (Protection 5) by a man who burst through a door on the base’s upper level, which took END to 0 and started eating STR, then hit again shortly after.
His own first aid failed. With no doctor in reach he used StClair’s medikit (TL10, DM+1) on himself and rolled Effect −4. The rules define no consequence for a failed first aid, so the GM homeruled it: no characteristics regained, no further damage, medikit spent. Gunner Gunnerson later broke off mid-firefight to bandage him for 1 point of END, and finally dragged him bodily to the escape capsules.
He was the one who held the escape capsule open for the others, and he wanted Harlen taken alive rather than shot — “shoot him in the legs, Gunner” — on the reasoning that Harlen wouldn’t blow a station he was still standing on. Harlen ran before anyone could try.
Previous condition — Regina, before the Odoy meeting
Hit for 11 damage (attack roll 12, Effect 2) during the attack at Dancado. Overflow taken on STR to protect DEX. He spent the rest of the fight hidden while the others stopped the two intruders — one killed, the other unconscious — with END 0 and STR 3 there was nothing else to do.
With the attack over but the sniper possibly still outside, Kostas and StClair entered the exposed lounge to retrieve Iaros Ujinka. As they entered, they saw a grav car flying away and thought it bore POC colours, though they could not confirm it.

























WasNowSTR73DEX109END71
StClair treated Kostas after the fight and restored 1 END. His current values are STR 3, DEX 9 and END 1; STR remains the thin one, and the arm that came off in his piracy days took the first bite out of it.
After returning to the hostel, Kostas tried to use the gunshot wound to win sympathy from Zena Antonia. It did not work.
Pallod Norrim later told him that short, red-haired Darrian Jak had been arrested for Vlen’s murder. Kostas questioned Pallod about the apparent POC grav car at Dancado, the connection between the murders and the localised systems failures; Pallod dismissed everything as coincidence and ended the call quickly. Kostas left Pallod’s secretary a message asking for an opportunity to face his uncle’s alleged killer.
Kostas researched Vlen’s unexplained age the following day but found nothing new.
Assumes no armour was subtracted from the 11.
First aid on himself: Average (8+) Medic check, EDU, 1D rounds, restores characteristic points equal to the Effect (minimum 1), split as he likes between STR and END. Needs at least a medikit, must be started within one minute of the injury, and can only be successfully applied once. Kostas has no Medic skill — DM-3, EDU 8 gives +0, so he needs 11+ on 2D. A TL10 medikit makes it 10+, TL12 makes it 9+.
The autodoc upstairs at Dancado has Medic 3 even in its basic form — vastly better odds than his own hands, if it has power and he gets to it inside the one-minute window.
Skills
Mechanic 1 · Electronics (Sensors) 1 · Astrogation 1 · Recon 1 · Vacc Suit 1
Mustering Out

Ship Share
INT +1
Cr20,000 — Cr10,000 cleared the medical debt, Cr10,000 remaining

History

Rejected by the military academy, then rejected as a navy volunteer — and promptly drafted into the navy anyway
Cryo freeze accident leaves him scarred
Works his way up to Petty Officer, 3rd class
Joins Tyrus Cassius’s mutiny, it fails, he’s punished
Leaves the navy in shame, tries piracy, loses an arm on his first boarding
Tries petty thieving; hasn’t got the temperament for it
Four years of odd jobs as a drifter; debt collectors take an eye, the replacement doubles what he owes
Pays off the debt, hears Tyrus Cassius is retiring as an Admiral, and talks his way aboard the Event Horizon to demand a job

Homeworld
Roup
Session 2026-10-04: the GM described Alell as where Kostas was born, with family there. Which is right, or whether both are (born on Alell, raised on Roup), is unresolved.
Ship
Crew of the Event Horizon, owned by Graxius StClair — Kostas’ Ship Share from mustering out went towards her. She carries the Pinnace Implacable, which belongs to Tyrus Cassius.
Connections

Ally — Vlen Backett (“Uncle Vlen”), extended family on Alell; his “loans” kept Kostas afloat. Murdered — Kostas is his registered next of kin and was summoned to Regina to deal with the estate and bring the body home. The body is now with the crew at Alell
Rival — Ven Yasha, the one name that came back when Kostas asked who was causing him trouble

Lightly flirting with Zena Antonia, receptionist at the Regina Down TAS Hostel where the party are staying
Family on Alell (Tel’s pre-session handout; Kostas knows them mostly through what his parents have told him):

Backett Family of Vaca Goya — Tomas Backett (merchant, disliked Vlen), Hans Backett (hunter, looking for an angle on Vlen’s fortune), Gunter Backett (15, always wants Kostas’s off-world stories), Nairal Backett (92, great-uncle, sharp)
Jocell Family — Marisa Jocell and her son Bard Jocell, the starport branch who look down on the Backetts
Also expected: Porter Sajan, Vaca Goya’s village porter, and possibly Yusul Parad, whom Vlen may have owed money

Session 2026-10-18: Vaca Goya on Alell is home. The village has his old school and the house he grew up in, and his parents still live there. He left “to secure my fortune, chase glory in the Navy”, which “could have gone better”. That supports the GM’s “born on Alell”. The Roup homeworld from character creation is still unreconciled

lambdragon.title: Lambdragon
lambdragon.content:
traveller sota species
Secrets of the Ancients
An animal. Large herbivore common to the Alell jungles.
Lambdragons graze slowly through the forest, eating from the treetops. Few natural predators, thanks to their size and the protection of the pack. The name comes from their perceived gentleness — but attacks are not impossible:

Two sets of teeth: an exterior set of flat teeth for feeding on leaves, and a retractable set of sharper teeth used in defence and mating rituals
A stampede of lambdragons can flatten a tank

They reproduce by depositing egg sacs in hollows in trees. The larval lambdragon feeds on the interior of the tree and ‘hatches’ when the weakened tree collapses. The passage of a large herd causes sizable seismic tremors, felling trees and so bringing new dragons into the herd.
Notes

llellewyoly.title: Llellewyoly
llellewyoly.content:
traveller sota species
Secrets of the Ancients
A minor race native to Junidy in the Aramis subsector of the Spinward Marches. Nicknamed ‘Dandelions’ or ‘Dandies’.

Resemble a two-metre-tall version of a Terran plant, with five stalk-like limbs used for manipulation, movement and sensing
Highly intelligent, with excellent memory recall and organisational skills — possibly a result of their incredibly complex social structure
A Llellewyoly holds dozens of formal titles simultaneously, and addressing one by the wrong title is a grievous insult
Rarely encountered outside their homeworld

Encountered
Exceedingly Discreet â€” met 196-1105 in a sealed environmental chamber inside Winter Shipping’s closed Credo-side building, where it serves as the company’s records and processing. It required a sealed atmosphere and its food is not fit for human consumption â€” StClair ate some and vomited.
The party’s library data claims the species uses a conventional oxygen/carbon-dioxide respiration cycle, which sits oddly with the sealed chamber. Unresolved.
Notes

maleficent.title: Maleficent
maleficent.content:
traveller sota species clue
Secrets of the Ancients
An animal. Infamous and mysterious predators of the Alell jungles — fast and brutal.

Jet-black, though markings can be seen under ultraviolet light
Travel through the trees by means of tentacles, snaking along the canopy in search of prey
Little is known about their biology

Some scientists believe they are not originally native to Alell.
That last line is why this note is tagged as a clue. A predator nobody can classify, with markings visible only outside the human visual range, on a world nobody can explain the wildlife of — in a campaign about a species that seeded life across hundreds of worlds. Noted, not concluded.
Notes

marid.title: Marid
marid.content:
traveller sota npc
Secrets of the Ancients
Receptionist at Winter Shipping’s Star Town office. Described as very attractive.
Met on 195-1105 when the crew walked in with a cargo sale as cover. The office interior is far smarter than its Star Town surroundings would suggest.
Nothing else established — how senior she is, what she knows, or whether she is connected to Harlen or Ven Yasha.
As of 196-1105 she is being kept out of the loop deliberately: Exceedingly Discreet intends to route the crew onto the company launch without Marid knowing, and Exceedingly Discreet directs all cargo enquiries to her â€” suggesting she handles the legitimate business and nothing else.
Notes

marisa-jocell.title: Marisa Jocell
marisa-jocell.content:
traveller sota npc alell
Secrets of the Ancients
Leader of the Jocell Family delegation on Alell. An “insufferable socialite”. Accompanied by her son Bard Jocell.
Source: Tel’s pre-session handout on Alell, mostly what Kostas’s parents have told him.
Appearance

Notes


Session 2026-10-18: at the homecoming with Bard. They work in the starport area. Overawed by the Admiral’s SOC 15, and plainly working out how to use it, but couldn’t resist a dig at Kostas: “I remember when you were a snotty little boy.” The Admiral said aloud that she’s hot. When StClair asked if she and Bard were husband and wife she blushed and noted he was unattached, then learned his SOC and put a handkerchief to her mouth

Her claim: “We’re not last in line. He owes me his spaceship. I’m not losing out to these monks and this wife.” See Claims on Vlen’s Estate

meeting-at-the-flotsam.title: Meeting at the Flotsam
meeting-at-the-flotsam.content:
traveller sota clue
Secrets of the Ancients
Detective Odoy met the party at The Flotsam at 10pm on 195-1105. The meeting happened — see Detective Odoy for the full account he gave.
He is investigating Ven Yasha, and told the crew that Yasha killed Vlen Backett, that Vlen was Yasha’s courier, that the Zhodani spy story is a cover for an Imperial takeover of the inquiry, that the Alahir’s Imperial force is hunting Yasha and has taken both Dancado attackers, and that the red-haired man is a fixer called Harlen linked to Winter Shipping. All of it unverified.
Still unknown how he made contact, which agency he belongs to, and what he wants from the crew — he arranged this, they didn’t.
Worth weighing against Being Followed: the party are already under Regina Public Order Commission observation, and a night meeting in a bar is not how the Commission has done business with them so far.
Notes

The crew plan to investigate Winter Shipping first, then attend this meeting as arranged.

menorb.title: Menorb
menorb.content:
traveller sota location
Secrets of the Ancients
An unremarkable agricultural planet, known mainly for producing food for export to the Vargr market.
That trade has drawn more than its share of raiders, who snack on Menorb before moving on to more profitable targets.
Notes

merrick-backett.title: Merrick Backett
merrick-backett.content:
traveller sota npc alell
Secrets of the Ancients
Kostas’s father, of the Backett Family in Vaca Goya on Alell. Married to Henna Backett. Name confirmed by Rich after Session 2026-10-18.
Most of what Kostas knew about the family before he arrived came through his parents: Tomas’s dislike of Vlen, Hans and the hidden fortune, Vlen’s debt to Yusul Parad.
Notes


Session 2026-10-18: at Vlen’s homecoming. “How are you keeping, boy? You look a mess, boy.” On Vlen: “Sad news about your uncle, although you won’t find any sad faces in there. We’re all waiting for that will reading.” He ran down who’d come: Tomas, Hans and Nairal, the Jocells, and the Parads (“watch your step”). He offered to keep Henna off Kostas’s back for the evening. Asked for a vehicle, he said it’s too dangerous to go out at this time of day, and there won’t be many shuttle pilots: “best to do that tomorrow, boy.” The Backetts have no security: “we’re not well-to-do”

morgan.title: Morgan
morgan.content:
traveller sota npc alell crime
Secrets of the Ancients
Yusul Parad’s bodyguard at Vlen’s homecoming in Vaca Goya (Session 2026-10-18). A “hunk of muscle”, unarmed, because guns are illegal on Alell. Yusul nods to him when he talks about his “negotiation skills”. He eyed the party as they walked past.
Notes

nairal-backett.title: Nairal Backett
nairal-backett.content:
traveller sota npc alell
Secrets of the Ancients
Kostas’s great-uncle, 92, the oldest member of the Backett Family — “if he is still kicking”.
“Mind like a steel trap”, Kostas’s parents say.
Source: Tel’s pre-session handout on Alell, mostly what Kostas’s parents have told him.
Notes


Session 2026-10-18: uncle of Tomas and Hans, so Kostas’s great-uncle. Looks close to death’s door. One of the few relatives Kostas likes. He cried and hugged him: “Good to see the family back together, boy. Been too long”

On Vlen: “I always remember being introduced to him. He was my great-uncle. Never understood it.” Didn’t look a day over 50. See Vlen Backett’s True Age
Vlen had a lodge out in the woods (not a hunting lodge; those aren’t allowed now), and sometimes came back with off-world people who’d go there. The family don’t know where it is. See Vlen’s Hidden Fortune

olso.title: Olso
olso.content:
traveller sota npc
Secrets of the Ancients
The crew’s contact at Winter Shipping, arranged on 195-1105.
Olso is collecting the crew’s cargo — the 3 tons of crystals and gems brought from Yori, bought for Cr54,000 and sold to Winter Shipping for Cr72,000. The sale was cover for investigating the company, and the collection gives the crew a legitimate reason to watch Winter Shipping personnel at work.
Nothing else established: role, seniority, or any connection to Harlen or Ven Yasha.
As with Marid, Olso is on the legitimate side of the business and appears to know nothing of Exceedingly Discreet or the crew’s arrangement with it.
Notes

orisa-backett.title: Orisa Backett
orisa-backett.content:
traveller sota npc alell
Secrets of the Ancients
Claims to be Vlen Backett’s wife. Arrived at his homecoming in Vaca Goya in Session 2026-10-18, shyly, after the Brotherhood of Humaniti monks: fully clothed, with hair, and a Southern accent (“my little chickadee”). Name heard several ways in the recording (first written up here as “Arisa”); spelling per Rich.

“My name is Orisa Backett. Vlen was my husband”
To Kostas: “I’m your aunt. Come here, my little nephew.” Big hug and a kiss on the cheek. She says she’s never met the family, and asked to be introduced
She has a wedding certificate, and shows it to anyone who’ll listen
Tomas Backett: “Her husband, Vlen? Rubbish.” He got flustered and kept glancing at Kostas
The Admiral doubts the certificate is worth the paper it’s written on

Nobody in the family knew Vlen had a wife. Unverified. See Claims on Vlen’s Estate.
Notes

ozymandius-forthrast.title: Ozymandius Forthrast
ozymandius-forthrast.content:
traveller sota character
Secrets of the Ancients
Player character. Crew of the Event Horizon.
Appearance

Lean, sharp-featured, short fair hair, tinted glasses. Long dark coat over a three-piece suit — waistcoat, tie, worn leather belt — and a small satchel at the hip. Carries a tablet in one hand, the other in a pocket. Reads as the one who handles the paperwork and the talking.
Notes

With the power still out after the attack at Dancado, Ozy ran to the utility room to try to restore it so the house’s autodoc could be used on Iaros Ujinka.
After the failed attempt to revive Ujinka, Ozy began searching her library for notes relevant to Ujinka’s Research.
He recovered unspecified data concerning Ujinka’s Ancients research, Vlen Backett and the g-band work.
After several attempts to repair Vlen’s smashed comms, he extracted the last-dialled number immediately before the device became unusable. It belongs to Winter Shipping.
196-1105: back to Winter Shipping’s Credo office with Cassius — his one good Recon roll found only a receipt for the crew’s own earlier trade. Brokered (Broker 1) for cargo at Regina and declined a 110% price on advanced electronics, burning the legal suppliers for a month. Knew Talia’s pay to the credit. Homeworld given by the GM as Uakye, next door to Alell. Intended to settle the Helix / Black Horizon dispute with Advocate, arguing a carrier clause in the charter contract — admitted it was a bluff
Transit to Alell (Session 2026-09-20): settled the Helix / Black Horizon row by pulling the logs and quantifying each side’s contribution — Electronics (Computers) +7, rolled 12, Effect +4, and the GM let him pick the outcome. Chose Black Horizon in the right, on the logic that the dodgy company in the right is easier to enforce against than the honest one in the wrong. Declined to fake the numbers or keep a private backup. Also rigged the DNA sensor that matched the ventilation goo to the empty skin suit (“the scanner in Alien”). Chatting up Khei, Black Horizon’s rep, who thinks he looks like an ex — successful roll, fade to black; cost him a couple of days of training. Training Persuade, two weeks by Whanga. Shot the first carthus in the shafts — no armour, nearly killed it. Carries explosives, no stunner
Session 2026-09-27: hit hard with his laser pistol (3D6+3) in the control room, and fixed the overloading power cables before they caused critical damage. Tried to Persuade Pedro (untrained; the GM refused to count it as on-the-job training). Carousing then Advocate (Effect +7) got Khei to explain the carthuses and offer Black Horizon’s Growth Serum. She kicked him out for the joke after. Visited Cassius naked. At Alell, his Computers roll established that Alell doesn’t normally have patrol ships. He asked Delta 2 for its handshake, which made it go dark. On sensors for the space fight: detected incoming missiles
Session 2026-10-04: has good Electronics but not Electronics (sensors), so he swapped with Kostas onto engineering. Engineer +4. Asked about prepping an emergency jump and checked the ship’s quirks (just −10 Hull). Rolled an overload in round 1 that the table held in reserve, then overloaded the manoeuvre drive in round 4 (rolled 12) for Thrust 3 in round 5, which paid for the Evasive Action. Spent the quiet rounds texting. After the fight he fixed the comms on an Engineer roll, and calmed the passengers with Advocate after Talia, then joked that a couple of them were paying extra for the excitement. No training from the three jumps, having been otherwise occupied
Session 2026-10-18: unarmed bar his fists (“Mr Lefty and Mr Righty”) until Kostas lent him the stun stick (StClair’s). At the homecoming he went straight for Tomas Backett, pitched export business (Alell trades exotic furs and unusual ores), and became Tomas’s “neutral third party” for the inheritance. When Tomas asked about the will he deferred to Kostas. Wants access to the village hall terminals to test the claims

pallod-norrim.title: Pallod Norrim
pallod-norrim.content:
traveller sota npc
Secrets of the Ancients
Chief Inspector of the Regina Public Order Commission.
Sent Kostas Backett the notification of Vlen Backett’s death (Handout 2), naming him next of kin and summoning him to Regina with all due haste. Wants Kostas to contact the Commission on arrival, citing irregularities in Vlen’s affairs — see Irregularities in Vlen Backett’s Affairs.
Opens the letter as Pallod Norrim and signs it Pallod Norum. Probably a typo. Probably.
Notes

Admiral Cassius reported the attack and its aftermath at Dancado to him.
Pallod later called Kostas Backett to say the POC had arrested short, red-haired Darrian Jak for Vlen’s murder.
Kostas asked about the apparent POC grav car at Dancado, the connection between the two murders and the attackers’ apparent ability to disable local systems. Pallod called it all coincidence and nothing to worry about, then ended the call quickly.
Kostas left a message with Pallod’s secretary thanking him for closing the investigation and asking for an opportunity to face his uncle’s alleged killer.
Admiral Cassius’s network reports that the captain of the Alahir has held numerous meetings with Pallod. This is not independently verified.
On 195-1105 Admiral Cassius called him to ask what had become of the surviving Dancado prisoner. Pallod is no longer taking the crew’s calls at all, and nothing was learned.
Detective Odoy contradicts Pallod’s entire case the same evening: he says Ven Yasha killed Vlen, that the red-haired man is a fixer called Harlen, and that the Zhodani-spy story is a cover for an Imperial takeover of the inquiry. Whether Pallod is bought, coerced or merely sidelined is unknown.

A family from Alell, unrelated to the Backetts, and a known local criminal gang with a fearsome reputation. Headed by Yusul Parad.

pedro.title: Pedro
pedro.content:
traveller sota npc
Secrets of the Ancients
Black Horizon security guard aboard the Event Horizon. A stat-block NPC with a stunner, sent into the maintenance shafts with the crew to recover Black Horizon’s escaped carthuses. Named at the table (“Pedro to Ops”). He’s probably the same unnamed security officer who went in with them last session, and the GM’s token calls him “Armed Security Guard, Black Horizon”.
Missed with his stunner more often than he hit, but stunned two of the carthuses, which makes him the reason any were taken alive. Kept telling the crew “we need to keep them alive… I’m going to get it in the neck for this”. When Ozy tried to get more out of him: “above my pay grade, mate”. Asked how many there were: “a handful”. Married.
Went ahead down a corridor alone and had a massive chunk bitten out of his shoulder (13 damage). His own first aid failed because his hands were slipping in the blood. Attacked again, he dived prone, “crying for his mummy”. Survived and called it in.

Session 2026-09-27: carthus hunt, third jump to Alell

pixie.title: Pixie

porter-sajan.content:

The current village porter of Vaca Goya on Alell, and one of its most important dignitaries.
He takes his responsibilities seriously, so Kostas’s parents advise playing it straight with him.
Inference, not stated: “porter” as a civic title probably descends from the hotel staff who founded Alell’s lodge-cities.

Session 2026-10-18: met at Vlen’s homecoming in the village hall. Tall, in ceremonial robes, with a doleful voice “as if apologising in advance”. Rao describes him as the village’s magistrate and spiritual leader

Expected the crew to bring the body and Vlen’s will. He’d been told Vlen would have a copy with him. Kostas has none. “There must be another copy somewhere”
Tonight the homecoming, tomorrow the burial and the reading of the will. He took charge of the body
Asked Kostas and his friends to act as intermediaries and resolve the claims before tomorrow (Claims on Vlen’s Estate), without waiting for a yes. He is busy with the Brotherhood of Humaniti’s demand for its own “DNA” ceremony for its initiate, which he calls preposterous. “I trust you and believe in you, Kostas”

rao's-map.title: Rao's Map
rao's-map.content:
traveller sota item alell
Secrets of the Ancients
A moth-eaten map from Rao’s paperwork, on which she marked roughly where she dropped Vlen Backett off in the Alell jungle, years ago. She collected him a week later. Bought by Kostas for Cr100 in Session 2026-10-18. “It’s been a while, though.”
Kostas has shown it to no one at the homecoming. He doesn’t trust anyone there.
Kostas thinks the mark is Vlen’s lodge in the woods. Nairal Backett says the lodge exists but the family don’t know where it is. See Vlen’s Hidden Fortune. The link between the drop-off point and the lodge is Kostas’s guess.
Notes

rao.title: Rao
rao.content:
traveller sota npc alell
Secrets of the Ancients
Air-shuttle pilot working the Alell Starport. Name read off her shuttle window: R-A-O, pronounced “Rayo”. Flew the party and Vlen’s cryotube to Vaca Goya in Session 2026-10-18.


Spotted the Backett family resemblance in Kostas. Has ferried Vlen around a few times over the years, and thought him “a bit secretive”
Gave the tour: Alell was a hunting ground for nobles before the First Imperium fell, and is now a mix of science and conservation. Most settlements have high walls, smaller ones a sensor grid. Never go into the jungle alone; take a guide. “This place can eat you alive if you let it”
Played along with Kostas’s made-up facts so as not to embarrass him

Vlen’s charter
Some while ago Vlen chartered her to fly him out into the middle of nowhere, no questions asked. She took the credits and left him. She picked him up a week later, unharmed. “He was mad for doing that.” For Cr100 from Kostas she marked the spot roughly on a moth-eaten map: Rao’s Map.
Kostas has her number for another ride.

regina-down-tas-hostel.title: Regina Down TAS Hostel
regina-down-tas-hostel.content:
traveller sota location
Secrets of the Ancients
The Travellers’ Aid Society hostel in Credo City where Vlen Backett was staying, and where he was murdered.
The party are staying here now. Zena Antonia works the reception desk.

Mail reached him here, care of the hostel — including Iaros Ujinka’s letter
Its security camera caught the Three Men at Vlen’s Room
The Smashed Comms came from his room here
Ozy worked on the smashed comms here and recovered the last-dialled number — Winter Shipping — immediately before the device became unusable
The receptionist on duty the night of the murder has been traced and interviewed — no use. Zena Antonia works the desk on other shifts

regina-highport.title: Regina Highport
regina-highport.content:
traveller sota location
Secrets of the Ancients
Class A starport, one of the largest in the entire Spinward Marches. It sees more traffic in a day than some lesser systems see in a decade.
Over 80% of the cargo passing through Regina is destined for other worlds in the sector, so most of the port is given over to cargo handling and warehousing.
Located in geostationary orbit over the Regina Downport and Startown, which sits halfway between the cities of Credo and Atora.
Presumably where the Event Horizon is berthed.
The Alahir reportedly arrived here several weeks before the party’s investigation. It is registered to the Scout Service but is not a standard scout design.
Notes

regina-public-order-commission.title: Regina Public Order Commission
regina-public-order-commission.content:
traveller sota faction
Secrets of the Ancients
The local police force of Regina. Pallod Norrim is a Chief Inspector. Its Regina Office sent the party the notice of Vlen Backett’s death on 190-1105.


                  
                  Law Level 9 — most personal weapons are banned 
                  
                

POC officers are also empowered to detain individuals or confiscate items judged “disruptive or damaging to public order and safety”. This has been used to control technologies and to restrict the movement of visitors to the moon.
In practice the POC is much more lenient in the most cosmopolitan cities; visitors to less trafficked regions are advised to exercise caution. Dancado is a forested region north of Credo City — not a cosmopolitan city.
The party fought a gun battle, killed one man and captured another on the Duke’s private property, on a world that bans most personal weapons, under a legal system with Assumption of Custody. The POC took custody of the surviving attacker.


Holds instructions left on file by Vlen Backett naming Kostas Backett his next of kin, and handles the estates and remains of the dead. Acts in the name of the Duke, under the Public Order Act of 527 (Amended) — which it used to require and enjoin Kostas to travel to Regina, with a reply demanded if he can’t.
Wants to speak to Kostas in person on arrival about irregularities in Vlen’s affairs — see Irregularities in Vlen Backett’s Affairs.
The party were tailed to Dancado by a POC grav car. As Kostas Backett and StClair entered the lounge after the attack, they saw a grav car flying away and thought it bore POC colours. The identification is unconfirmed. See Being Followed.
The officers who arrived afterward said they were the only POC personnel in the area and dismissed the crew’s identification of the departing vehicle. Admiral Cassius’s network later reported that offworlders have operated in POC uniforms since the Alahir arrived, potentially explaining the discrepancy; this remains unconfirmed.
The POC arrested Darrian Jak, and Pallod Norrim told Kostas that Jak murdered Vlen. Pallod dismissed the apparent POC vehicle, the link to Ujinka’s murder and the localised system failures as coincidence before ending the call quickly. The crew regard his response and the sudden closure of the case as suspicious.
Rumour says the local POC are angry that an Imperial police force has taken over a murder inquiry as a state-security matter. A further rumour identifies the victim as a Zhodani spy. Neither the takeover nor the victim’s identity is confirmed.
Powers
Assumption of Custody — the Commission can detain suspects for up to a month without trial, and Travellers are one of the groups it sweeps as a matter of routine. The single biggest legal threat hanging over the party.
Notes

regina.title: Regina
regina.content:
traveller sota location
Secrets of the Ancients
Capital of the Regina subsector of the Spinward Marches, and seat of the Duchy of Regina — one of the most important worlds in the sector. A bulwark against Zhodani aggression and the largest trade hub in the Marches. Vessels travelling the Spinward Main from the Core worlds offload their cargoes here, leaving smaller local traders to carry goods on to lesser systems.
Technically Regina is a moon, not a planet. It orbits the gas giant Assiniboia, which orbits the locus of the primary star Lusor and its companion Speck. A third star, a red dwarf, runs a long eccentric orbit.
Its subsector contains Alell.
Living here

Ports: Regina Highport in geostationary orbit, and the downport at Startown
Cities: Credo City and Atora, with Startown split between them
Law Level 9 — most personal weapons are banned. See Regina Public Order Commission

Ven Yasha is wanted by numerous worlds around Regina.
Vlen Backett was murdered in Credo City here, three days after arriving from Rhylanor, and Kostas Backett has been summoned to deal with his estate. Dancado is also on Regina. Civil authority is the Regina Public Order Commission, acting in the name of the Duke; the First Ducal Bank holds money set aside for Kostas’ expenses.
Regina’s legal system is curious and strict: laws must be voted on by the entire population, and the justice system is as bureaucratic as it is enthusiastic without being efficient at either. Assumption of Custody — a month’s detention without trial, disproportionately aimed at transients and Travellers — is therefore something the population of Regina voted for.
“Regina” is used for both the subsector and its namesake world — the handouts don’t distinguish. Split this note if the world itself comes up.
Notes

rhylanor.content:

roup.content:

Homeworld of Kostas Backett.
travellermap.com/%2173.119%218.15
A water world. The only stable ‘land’ consists of synthetic islands grown from webs of micro-organisms and seaweed — huge rafts supporting vast cities, factories, farmland and even the starport.
Roup’s citizens practise aquaculture on a planetary scale, with whole oceans sectioned off using bubble-nets to maximise productivity.

Worth noting
Tusal is derived from a seaweed. Kostas grew up on a world whose entire economy is farmed seaweed and micro-organism rafts. Probably nothing — Tusal is grown along the Corridor sector and has been in Imperial space a century — but the man whose uncle was killed with a seaweed narcotic comes from a planet of seaweed farms.

session-2026-08-02.title: Session 2026-08-02
session-2026-08-02.content:
traveller sota session
Secrets of the Ancients
Session date: 2026-08-02
Starting in-fiction date: 193-1105
Starting position
The session resumed immediately after the attack at Dancado. Iaros Ujinka had been shot through the upstairs lounge window, the power and security drone had been taken out, and the third shooter remained outside and unidentified. Of the two intruders who entered the house, one was dead and the other unconscious. Kostas Backett was badly wounded at END 0 and STR 3. A grav car believed to belong to the POC was outside.
Live notes

The power was still out, so the upstairs autodoc would not work
Ozy ran to the ground-floor utility room to try to restore power
Admiral Cassius began tying up the unconscious intruder
Kostas Backett and StClair entered the exposed upstairs lounge to retrieve Ujinka, moving carefully in case the sniper still had a line of fire
As Kostas and StClair entered the lounge, they saw a grav car flying away. They thought it bore POC colours, but the identification was unconfirmed
Kostas and StClair got Ujinka to the autodoc, but it was too late to revive her
StClair treated Kostas’s injuries and restored 1 END, bringing him to END 1
Ozy began searching Ujinka’s library for notes relevant to her research
Admiral Cassius began calling Chief Inspector Pallod Norrim to report the situation
The crew planned to search the other rooms before the authorities arrived
With the authorities almost at Dancado, the crew began bringing the unconscious intruder around so they could question him first
The questioning produced little, but the intruder mentioned Ven Yasha. What connection Yasha has to the attack was not established
The arriving officers said they were the only POC personnel in the area and believed the crew had mistaken the identity of the grav car seen leaving
After dealing with the authorities at Dancado, the crew headed back to the Regina Down TAS Hostel
Ozy recovered data from Ujinka’s house concerning her Ancients research, Uncle Vlen, and the G-band work. The GM gave no specific contents yet, but the data may become useful later
The crew decided to remain at the hostel and try to repair Vlen’s smashed comms device
Kostas tried to use being shot to win sympathy from Zena Antonia, but it did not work
Ozy made some progress repairing Vlen’s smashed comms, but completing the repair will take several attempts
The crew returned to the commercial-district alleys to find Darrian Jak, but learned that the police had apparently picked him up earlier that day
Pallod Norrim called Kostas and said the POC had arrested Darrian Jak for Vlen’s murder. Pallod confirmed that Jak is a short redhead
Kostas asked Pallod about the suspected POC grav car, the connection to Ujinka’s shooting, and the attackers’ apparent ability to disable systems in a localised area. Pallod dismissed everything as coincidence and nothing to worry about, then quickly ended the call. Kostas found this very suspicious
Kostas left a message with Pallod’s secretary thanking him for closing the investigation and asking for an opportunity to face his uncle’s alleged killer
The crew went to bed. The following day, they were due to meet Detective Odoy that night
During the day, Ozy continued working on the smashed comms, Kostas researched Vlen’s unexplained age, and Admiral Cassius used his network to build influence on Regina beyond Pallod
Before the smashed comms became fully damaged, Ozy recovered the last number called from the device. It belongs to Winter Shipping, a logistics company operating in both Credo City and Star Town
Kostas found nothing new about Vlen’s true age
Admiral Cassius’s network reported that a ship called the Alahir arrived at Regina Highport several weeks ago. It is registered to the Scout Service but is not a standard scout design
The Alahir’s captain reportedly held numerous meetings with Pallod Norrim, and offworlders have reportedly been seen operating in POC uniforms since the ship arrived
The local POC are reportedly angry that an Imperial police force has taken over a murder inquiry
Rumour says the murdered man was a Zhodani spy and that the inquiry has become a matter of state security. The source did not establish the victim’s identity or confirm the rumour
Star Town is a thin strip between Credo City and Atora
An existing Winter Shipping advert offers to buy cargo from crews struggling with mortgage payments, salaries, or repairs, promising “Prompt service. No questions asked.”


Decisions and discoveries

One of the two intruders survived, mentioned Ven Yasha during questioning, and then entered POC custody
The suspected POC grav car left immediately after the attack rather than intervening; its identity and role remain unconfirmed
Ujinka is confirmed dead; the autodoc revival attempt was too late
The crew chose to notify the POC through Pallod before the authorities arrived
The surviving intruder connected the name Ven Yasha to the situation, but gave no clear explanation of his role
The POC deny having another vehicle in the area. This leaves the departing grav car unidentified; either the crew misread its colours, it was impersonating the POC, or the officers’ account is incomplete. These possibilities are unconfirmed
Ozy now holds potentially useful research data from Ujinka’s house, but its specific contents and significance remain undefined
The crew prioritised repairing Vlen’s comms while waiting for the meeting with Odoy
Pallod now officially identifies Darrian Jak as Vlen’s killer and confirms Jak is a short redhead. This is the POC’s claim, not yet independently verified by the crew
Pallod dismissed the grav car, Ujinka murder, and localised system failures as coincidences and ended the call quickly; the crew regard his response as suspicious
The last-dialled number recovered from Vlen’s comms belongs to Winter Shipping, providing a new lead to the logistics and loans company operating in both Credo City and Star Town
Winter Shipping publicly advertises no-questions-asked cargo purchases aimed at financially distressed ship crews
Research into Vlen’s impossible age produced no new information
The Alahir and its captain provide a new link to Pallod and to apparent offworlders operating in POC uniforms
The offworlders in POC uniforms could explain the grav car seen leaving Dancado despite the local officers’ denial that another POC unit was present; this is an inference, not confirmed
Imperial police may have displaced the local POC from the murder investigation, while the Zhodani-spy and state-security claims remain unverified rumours

End position

The crew are back at the Regina Down TAS Hostel on the day of their scheduled 10pm meeting with Detective Odoy at The Flotsam
Iaros Ujinka is confirmed dead. The surviving intruder is in POC custody after mentioning Ven Yasha during the crew’s brief questioning
Pallod Norrim claims that short, red-haired Darrian Jak murdered Vlen and treats the case as solved, but the crew do not trust his explanation
Ozy recovered Ujinka’s research data, although its contents remain unspecified, and extracted the last-dialled number from Vlen’s comms before the device became fully damaged
The last-dialled number belongs to Winter Shipping, a logistics and cargo-buying company operating in both Credo City and Star Town
Admiral Cassius learned of the Alahir, its captain’s meetings with Pallod, offworlders in POC uniforms, and rumours of an Imperial police takeover involving state security and a supposed Zhodani spy
Kostas remains injured at STR 3, DEX 9 and END 1

Priorities for next session

Investigate Winter Shipping, including its Credo City and Star Town operations and why Vlen called it
Meet Detective Odoy at The Flotsam at 10pm as arranged
Follow the Alahir, its captain’s relationship with Pallod, and the offworlders reportedly operating in POC uniforms
Test Pallod’s claim that Darrian Jak killed Vlen and clarify the state-security and Zhodani-spy rumours

session-2026-08-16.title: Session 2026-08-16
session-2026-08-16.content:
traveller sota session
Secrets of the Ancients
Session date: 2026-08-16
Starting in-fiction date: 195-1105
Starting position
The crew are back at the Regina Down TAS Hostel on 195-1105, the day of their 10pm meeting with Detective Odoy at The Flotsam.

Iaros Ujinka is confirmed dead after the attack at Dancado. One attacker died; the survivor is in POC custody after mentioning Ven Yasha under questioning. The third man is still loose
A grav car apparently in POC colours left Dancado immediately after the attack; local officers deny any other POC unit was present
Pallod Norrim claims Darrian Jak, a short redhead, murdered Vlen Backett and treats the case as closed. The crew do not consider that proven and found his manner suspicious
Ozy holds research data recovered from Ujinka’s house (contents unspecified) and pulled the last-dialled number from Vlen’s comms before the device failed — it belongs to Winter Shipping
Admiral Cassius learned of the Alahir, its captain’s repeated meetings with Pallod, offworlders reportedly wearing POC uniforms, and rumours of an Imperial state-security takeover of the murder inquiry
Kostas Backett remains badly injured: STR 3, DEX 9, END 1
Ujinka’s request that the Event Horizon back Ujinka’s Research is still unanswered

Live notes

The crew split to work the Winter Shipping lead: Ozy to research the company and attempt a remote hack of its systems, while Kostas Backett goes to the premises in person to recon the building. Kostas is still badly injured (END 1)
Winter Shipping’s premises are two buildings, one either side of the fence between Credo City and Star Town. The crew are approaching from the Credo side
Kostas rolled well and located the offices. The Credo-side building is closed, with a notice directing callers to the Star Town offices, which are visible across the fence
A huge brute of a man entered the Credo-side building and emerged on the Star Town side — a crossing that is not supposed to be possible. This implies a connection or passage through the fence between the two buildings
Kostas and StClair scoped out the security system. It looks unsophisticated; the crew believe they could shut down the alarms if they decide to break in
Ozy successfully hacked Winter Shipping’s systems remotely, but found almost nothing of interest — suspiciously little. The crew suspect the real records sit on a separate, unconnected system
The Star Town side operates a launch that runs up to Regina Highport
Ozy found flight records showing that some of those launch runs take hours longer than the trip should
The crew decided against breaking in for now. Plan: cross into Star Town, walk into the Winter Shipping offices with a legitimate piece of business as cover, and see what they can learn face to face
Kostas Backett bought a dagger in Star Town for protection. Regina is Law Level 9, where all weapons are banned — carrying it is illegal anywhere on the moon. The crew judge Star Town lawless enough to carry it there, and Kostas intends to drop it before returning to Credo City
Inside, the Star Town Winter Shipping office is very fancy — far smarter than the surroundings suggest. Behind the desk is Marid, a very attractive receptionist
The legitimate business used as cover was the crew’s cargo from Yori: 3 tons of crystals and gems, bought for Cr54,000 and sold for Cr72,000 — a Cr18,000 profit. That is the Event Horizon’s entire 3-ton hold
The sale is to Winter Shipping itself. Olso, the crew’s Winter Shipping contact, will be picking the cargo up — giving the crew a legitimate reason to observe Winter Shipping personnel and their collection process
Admiral Cassius called Pallod Norrim to try to find out what happened to the surviving Dancado intruder taken into POC custody
Pallod Norrim is no longer taking the crew’s calls. Nothing was learned about the prisoner
The crew set off for the 10pm meeting with Detective Odoy at The Flotsam
Detective Odoy tells the crew he is investigating Ven Yasha, and that he believes Ven Yasha killed Vlen Backett — directly contradicting Pallod Norrim’s official line that Darrian Jak is the murderer. Odoy’s claim is unverified
Odoy’s theory is that Vlen was working as a courier for Ven Yasha. Unverified, but it would fit Vlen’s constant travel and improbable contacts
Further from Odoy (all his account, unverified):

No Zhodani spy was killed. The murder behind the rumour is Vlen, and he was not a spy — the spy story is a cover used to justify the Imperial police takeover of the inquiry
Imperial security have been everywhere on Regina
The Imperial force that arrived aboard the Alahir are after Ven Yasha
Odoy knows little about Iaros Ujinka or why she would be killed
The Dancado prisoner is no longer in POC custody — and the Imperial force also collected the other man from that attack
The red-haired man appears to be a fixer called Harlen, who is connected to Winter Shipping


Open question: Pallod Norrim named the short redhead as Darrian Jak and arrested him; Odoy names the red-haired man as Harlen. Whether Jak and Harlen are the same person, two different redheads, or an alias is not established

Decisions and discoveries

Winter Shipping occupies two buildings straddling the Credo City/Star Town fence, with an apparent internal passage between them — a man was seen entering one side and emerging on the other
The Credo-side office is closed and redirects callers to Star Town. Security on the premises is unsophisticated and the crew believe they could defeat the alarms
Winter Shipping’s networked systems hold almost nothing. The crew infer a second, unconnected system holding the real records — an inference, not confirmed
Winter Shipping runs a launch from the Star Town side to Regina Highport, and some of those runs take hours longer than the journey should. Unexplained
The crew sold their Yori cargo — 3 tons of crystals and gems — to Winter Shipping for Cr72,000 against a Cr54,000 outlay, using the sale as cover and a way to observe the company. Olso is the contact collecting it
Pallod Norrim has stopped taking the crew’s calls entirely. Nothing was learned about the Dancado prisoner through him
Detective Odoy gave a wholly different account of the case from Pallod’s. Everything below is Odoy’s claim and none of it is independently verified:

Ven Yasha, not Darrian Jak, killed Vlen Backett
Vlen was a courier for Ven Yasha
The Zhodani spy story is false. The murder it refers to is Vlen’s, and the spy framing exists to justify the Imperial police takeover of the inquiry
The Imperial force aboard the Alahir is hunting Ven Yasha, and Imperial security are all over Regina
Both Dancado attackers — the dead man and the prisoner — have been taken by that Imperial force. The prisoner is no longer in POC custody
The red-haired man is a fixer named Harlen, connected to Winter Shipping
Odoy has no explanation for Iaros Ujinka’s murder


Two independent sources now attach Ven Yasha to the case: the Dancado prisoner named him under questioning, and Odoy’s whole investigation is built on him
Unresolved identity: Pallod’s arrested suspect Darrian Jak and Odoy’s fixer Harlen are both short red-haired men tied to this murder. Whether they are the same man, an alias, or two people is not established
Harlen’s link to Winter Shipping ties the crew’s own recon to Odoy’s account: the same company took Vlen’s last call, employs a fixer matching the third man, and runs unexplained flights to the Highport
Odoy’s own agency, motives and reason for approaching the crew remain unrecorded

End position

The crew are at The Flotsam on the night of 195-1105, having just heard out Detective Odoy
The POC’s official case (Jak did it, case closed) and Odoy’s account (Yasha did it, the Imperials are hunting Yasha, the spy story is a cover) are in direct conflict. The crew have no way yet to test either
Pallod Norrim is unreachable; both Dancado attackers are beyond the crew’s reach in Imperial hands
Winter Shipping is now the strongest live lead: Vlen’s last call, Harlen’s employer, an internal fence crossing, a soft alarm system and unexplained Highport launches
The crew are up Cr18,000 on the Yori cargo, with the Event Horizon’s 3-ton hold empty pending collection by Olso
Kostas Backett remains injured at STR 3, DEX 9, END 1
Iaros Ujinka’s request that the Event Horizon back Ujinka’s Research is still unanswered

Priorities for next session

Break into Winter Shipping — the alarms look beatable; the targets are the second, unnetworked system, the passage between the two buildings, and anything on the Highport launch runs
Find out more about the Alahir — its captain, its crew, and the Imperial force Odoy says it carries
Try to meet Darrian Jak in prison — test Pallod’s case and settle whether Jak is Harlen

session-2026-08-23.title: Session 2026-08-23
session-2026-08-23.content:
traveller sota session
Secrets of the Ancients
Session date: 2026-08-23
In-fiction date: 195-1105, evening, running into the early hours of 196-1105
Starting position
The crew are at The Flotsam late on 195-1105, having just heard out Detective Odoy.

Two irreconcilable accounts of Vlen Backett’s Murder are on the table: the POC’s (Darrian Jak did it, closed) and Odoy’s (Ven Yasha did it, Vlen was his courier, the Imperials are here for Yasha). Neither verified
Pallod Norrim is unreachable; both Dancado attackers are in Imperial hands
Winter Shipping is the strongest lead: Vlen’s last call, Harlen’s employer, two buildings straddling the Credo City/Star Town fence, soft alarms, a near-empty network and launch runs to Regina Highport that take hours too long
The crew are Cr18,000 up on the Yori cargo, sold to Winter Shipping as cover; Olso is collecting it
Kostas Backett remains injured at STR 3, DEX 9, END 1

Live notes

Planning discussion first. Options weighed: break into Winter Shipping, visit Darrian Jak in prison, investigate the Alahir. The break-in won
The Event Horizon, in orbit around Assiniboia, can track Winter Shipping’s launch once it lifts. There is only one launch, parked by the Star Town office. Tracking alone is impractical without knowing which run is the anomalous one — hence the need for the flight schedule
Rejected as unworkable: astrogation to narrow down destinations from flight durations, faking shipping documents (nobody has Streetwise), buying or building tracking drones, and shipping Kostas up in a crate
The crew have no weapons — Regina is Law Level 9. StClair has a plastic knife
They approached the closed Credo-side office after dark. The group stealth check failed — the party were seen loitering and their presence noted as suspicious. They withdrew and tried again
Long tangent on distractions (faking a heart attack for the Admiral, StClair stabbing him in the leg, a bomb in a bin). None used
Kostas went in alone and aced it. He reached the building unseen, disabled the alarms on an electronics/sensors roll, slipped inside and opened a side access for the others
Inside the Credo-side building: dark, mostly empty crate tables — and one room in the far corner with a door ajar, light, muttering and the tapping of data pads
Through the door: a hermetically sealed environmental chamber with a Llellewyoly — a “Dandelion” — inside, working an enormous volume of data across multiple pads and monitors on a closed system. This is why the hacked server held nothing
Below the floor the crew found a ramp down into a tunnel running towards the Star Town building. Not concealed. Down the tunnel: a newer pipe with vents at equal intervals (unexplained), and a storeroom holding empty gin bottles and crates of non-human food. StClair ate some and vomited. The far end has a ramp up on the Star Town side, closed, with no mechanism visible from the tunnel
Long argument over killing it, kidnapping it, poisoning its food or hacking it. An electronics check confirmed no external route into its system — kidnap or conversation only. The crew chose to talk
Ozy and Cassius knocked on the glass. It answered on a comm unit: “I am exceedingly discreet. What is your title at this time, strangers?” — recorded as Exceedingly Discreet. It addresses everyone by invented titles: “overly dressed pompous man” (Cassius), “pale-skinned smartly dressed man” (Ozy), “downtrodden depressed man” (Kostas), “unruly-haired rude scientist man” (StClair, after he greeted it as a “ballsack with chicken legs”)
Cassius’ cover story — an external security audit — was dismissed as illogical, as was a follow-up about missing cargo. The crew then told it the truth: Vlen’s murder, Iaros Ujinka’s murder, the TAS footage, the man present at both killings, the POC-liveried grav car, The Device, and that they are looking for Harlen and for Ven Yasha
It took the truth well. It is the brains of the operation, and says Harlen runs the company — “short-sighted and a poor tactician”, but loyal. Ven Yasha hired them all. It thinks Harlen is not the right person to be running Winter Shipping long-term, and that the crew’s evidence marks him as a failure
The deal, agreed: it puts the crew on Winter Shipping’s launch and up to the company’s station in orbit, where Harlen is. In return the crew guarantee Harlen does not survive, and never report the conversation. Its own ambition — taking over the company — is the crew’s guarantee it won’t turn them in
It can control the launch’s flight path from its terminal. Marid does not need to know. It suggests the launch rendezvous with the Event Horizon in orbit so the crew can arm themselves — they will have to deal with the station’s staff and Harlen, and Credo weapons law makes arming on the ground impossible
What it gave up, all its own account and unverified:

Ven Yasha ordered Iaros Ujinka’s death. It does not understand why, and says so plainly — greater understanding of Ancient technology would only raise the value of Ancient artefacts
Vlen Backett was a messenger for Ven Yasha — “he must have brought bad news, hence his demise”
It was aware of both murders
On what Yasha wants from Ancient technology: nobody understands the secrets of the Ancients, but the potential runs to immortality, taking systems, taking the Imperium, destroying armies. It knows of no specific plan
Harlen holds some of Vlen’s possessions — a statuette, and data crystals. Volunteered unprompted, because Kostas is his nephew
Imperial Intelligence were on Regina in numbers. They arrived on the Alahir, which has since departed — whatever their business was, it is concluded. The captain’s name was heard as “Gand Hulses” (spelling unconfirmed) and he is said to hold some special portfolio in the intelligence services. It does not know whether they came for Yasha or for something else
It refuses to discuss Ven Yasha himself at all — “for my own survival” — while offering information on Harlen, on the hired thugs, and on Imperial Intelligence
On Harlen’s weaknesses: none as such. Loyal to Yasha and not for turning. “He is just a man, though”


Session ended in the small hours of 196-1105, in the Credo-side office, deal struck

Decisions and discoveries

Winter Shipping’s real records live in a Llellewyoly’s head and on a closed system in the Credo-side office. The empty server is explained
Exceedingly Discreet — the Llellewyoly — is now an ally of convenience with its own agenda: it wants Harlen dead and the company for itself
Harlen runs Winter Shipping, and Ven Yasha hired all of them. First confirmation from inside the company of the Yasha link that Detective Odoy alleged
Ven Yasha ordered Iaros Ujinka’s murder (per Exceedingly Discreet). The motive is unexplained even to the company’s own brain
Vlen Backett was Yasha’s messenger — a second, independent version of Odoy’s courier claim
Harlen holds Vlen’s statuette and data crystals — the first concrete object of Vlen’s known to be in the killers’ hands
There is a Winter Shipping station in orbit — the destination of the overlong launch runs, and where Harlen is
The Alahir has left Regina, its Imperial Intelligence contingent’s business concluded. Its captain reportedly holds a special intelligence portfolio; name heard as “Gand Hulses”, spelling and identity unconfirmed
The tunnel between the two buildings is real and unconcealed, with a closed ramp at the Star Town end and an unexplained newer, vented pipe running its length
The party still have no weapons and no Streetwise; almost every plan this session failed on a missing skill
The crew have promised to kill Harlen. Nobody has yet raised what happens if that turns out to be a lie told to them by a plant

End position

Early hours of 196-1105, inside the closed Credo-side Winter Shipping office, with the deal struck and Exceedingly Discreet still at its console
The route up is arranged: Winter Shipping’s launch, its flight path set by Exceedingly Discreet, with a rendezvous with the Event Horizon in orbit to collect weapons before boarding the station
Marid, Olso and the rest of the company are unaware of any of it
